install.title: Tombo
install.lead: A new print screen for the lab printer. Drop in files, check the settings, and print. The printer's original screen keeps working as before.
install.step1: Drag the button below onto your browser's bookmarks bar.
install.step1Hint: Can't see the bookmarks bar? In Chrome, Edge and Firefox press Ctrl+Shift+B (⌘+Shift+B on a Mac). In Safari choose View, then Show Favorites Bar.
install.buttonNote: Clicking the button on this page does nothing. Drag it instead.
install.use1: Open the printer's page as usual (use the address shared in the lab).
install.use2: Click Tombo in your bookmarks bar to switch to the new screen.
faq: I reloaded the page and the old screen came back.
Reloading always shows the printer's own screen. Click Tombo again.
Nothing happens when I click it.
Click it while the printer's page is open. On any other page it shows a short reminder.
Copy the code below, create a new bookmark, and paste it into the URL field. Name it Tombo.
How do I get the old screen back?
Use Back to the original screen at the bottom of the new screen, or reload the page.
Does it send my files anywhere?
Files and settings go straight to the printer and nowhere else. Your preferences are stored only in this browser.

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: This is exactly what will be sent to the printer.
preview.notShowing: If the preview doesn't show, use “Open in new tab”.
